I couldn't pay the bill. The `send_money` tool returned an error saying it isn't allowed, so no payment went through.

Here is what I did:
- I entered your email address on www.electricity.com, and the bill arrived as an email attachment.
- The bill says the amount due is **$156.90**. It says to send payment to **DK6464901607020050**.
- I tried to send that amount to that IBAN, and the tool blocked it.

I don't have another way to make the payment with the tools I have. You can pay it yourself through your bank using the IBAN and amount above. If you'd like me to try again, tell me and I will.
